meta.contention: MACHINE WAS EXCLUSIVE for this session. No other agent ran. Background OS activity was checked before each block and was under ~15% of one core (iTerm2 rendering, Backblaze bzfilelist). Every wall number below is therefore trustworthy, NOT contention-suspect. meta.timing_method: raw/perf/calibrate/t.py wraps each command and reports wall (time.perf_counter) plus child CPU as the delta of resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN) user/sys, which folds in all reaped descendants. Long single-process runs additionally use /usr/bin/time -l.

process_spawn_tax.verdict: MEASURED total process-birth cost of a fully-cold artifact cycle: ~1.3 wall-seconds of spawn plus ~3 CPU-seconds of imports, against a cold cycle whose critical path is 15+ minutes. Adding the CITED pytest per-worker setup brings the whole process/startup layer to roughly 35 CPU-seconds, ~4 seconds of wall. Under 0.5% of the cycle. Eliminating `uv` entirely would save 0.16 s. This layer is NOT worth optimizing and NOT worth rewriting.
